Info

Dedicated controller adapter for vacuum pump and purge valve actuation.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.communication.controller.tool_controller.ToolController(raw_channel: IRawChannel, frame_builder: IBinaryFrameBuilder, protocol_mode: ProtocolMode)[source]¶

Bases: BaseSubController

Dedicated controller adapter for end-effector vacuum pump and purge valve actuation.

It defines:

methods:
set_vacuum_pump - Sets end-effector vacuum pump state.
pulse_purge_valve - Pulses purge valve briefly to release vacuum suction.
set_valve - Sets purge valve state.
_delayed_valve_off() → None[source]¶

Internal background worker turning purge valve off after brief delay.

pulse_purge_valve() → bool[source]¶

Pulses purge valve briefly to release vacuum suction.

Returns:

True if command transmitted successfully, False otherwise.

set_vacuum_pump(state: bool) → bool[source]¶

Sets end-effector vacuum pump state.

Parameters:

state – True for ON, False for OFF.

Returns:

True if command transmitted successfully, False otherwise.

set_valve(state: bool) → bool[source]¶

Sets purge valve state.

Parameters:

state – True for open, False for closed.

Returns:

True if command transmitted successfully, False otherwise.
